name: GraphArena
description: GraphArena is a benchmarking tool designed to evaluate large language models on real-world graph computational problems, including polynomial-time and NP-complete tasks. It provides a rigorous evaluation framework classifying outputs as correct, suboptimal, hallucinatory, or missing.
reputation: A recent arXiv benchmark that is gaining attention in graph-reasoning evaluation, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes 4 polynomial-time and 6 NP-complete graph problems; evaluates hallucination and suboptimality in LLM outputs.
